docs.text: Raspberry Pi 5 can bog down when a local model overruns RAM.
On Raspberry Pi 5, that kind of slowdown usually means memory pressure rather than a CPU bottleneck.
Raspberry Pi 5 users often enable zram so compressed pages stay in memory before disk swap.
Once swap traffic reaches storage, latency jumps sharply.

query: What should I switch on when a Pi 5 starts crawling during on-device inference?

docs.text: On Debian system Python, Seahorse may start without semantic lookup.
Seahorse activates sqlite-vec through SQLite loadable extensions.
If sqlite3.enable_load_extension is missing, the vector path cannot be turned on.
Without vector search, Seahorse can still traverse phrase and passage links.

query: Why does Seahorse stay in graph-only mode under distro Python?

docs.text: By default, Seahorse keeps its state under the current working directory.
The database location is derived from DATA_DIR.
Set DATA_DIR to move knowledge_graph.db out of the repo root.
